method: Public official documentation reads only; no account/API authentication, supplier contact or notification

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 role attributes
sources.observation: Ordinary creator receives automatic ADMIN membership with SET/INHERIT false; administration differs from assumption.
sources.designInference: Provider cleanup authority must be established, not inferred from CREATEROLE.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 CREATE ROLE
sources.observation: Roles are cluster-wide; attributes and memberships are separate capabilities.
sources.designInference: Serialize shared-role lifecycle across app/CMS operations.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 REVOKE
sources.observation: Membership/privilege revocation depends on existing grants and authority.
sources.designInference: Inspect both membership directions and grantors, not command success alone.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 ALTER DATABASE
sources.observation: Ordinary ownership transfer requires CREATEDB and ability to assume the new owner.
sources.designInference: Exact provider ownership handoff is an unresolved capability.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 SET ROLE
sources.observation: Actual current role controls permission checks; SET membership options govern assumption.
sources.designInference: Do not equate SET permission with executing default-ACL work as owner.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES
sources.observation: Defaults concern future objects and the creating role; existing objects need separate ACL review.
sources.designInference: Validate global/schema defaults and existing object controls independently.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 CREATE DATABASE
sources.observation: Database creation cannot run in a transaction block.
sources.designInference: Journal partial/unknown setup; do not promise atomic cross-DB provisioning.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 SET TRANSACTION
sources.observation: Read-only access mode and repeatable-read isolation are explicit transaction properties.
sources.designInference: Use catalog-query allowlists plus transaction bounds; not a substitute for target/credential controls.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 ALTER ROLE
sources.observation: Self-password changes and administration of other roles have different privilege conditions.
sources.designInference: Separate rotation authority and session handling from bootstrap replay.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 SQL dump
sources.observation: Per-database dumps omit cluster roles; different databases do not share one dump snapshot.
sources.designInference: Reconstruct restricted roles with fresh target secrets and reconcile app/CMS restore windows.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 pg_restore
sources.observation: Ownership restoration depends on options and session authority.
sources.designInference: Verify actual restored ownership/ACLs; restoration is not role provisioning.

sources.title: DigitalOcean PostgreSQL user privileges
sources.observation: Advanced username alphabet omits underscores; new Advanced users have CREATEDB unless removed.
sources.designInference: Exact project names/flags need separate edition-specific proof; no mapping or waiver approved.

sources.title: DigitalOcean PostgreSQL limits
sources.observation: Customer superuser access is not provided.
sources.designInference: Local fixture superuser success does not establish a provider-supported privileged setup mechanism.
